punchline: The lawyer with the red Ferrari in the middle of his driveway had to sell it to find out why he had collapsed.
thirty_sec: In Robin Sharma's fable, Julian Mantle is a star trial lawyer with a Ferrari, a jet and a mansion. He also can't sleep, his marriage is over, and at fifty-three he looks nearly eighty. One Monday he has a heart attack in court. His doctor says: the Law or your life. He sells everything, goes to India and finds the Sages of Sivana. Three years later he walks into his old colleague's office looking decades younger.
